content:
Mira: kicking off 20% canary for release 2026.3 now, running sim-userflow replays against eu-embed route. please eyeball synth probes.
Sam: copied. any numbers yet?
Mira: p50 unchanged, p95 ~+120ms vs baseline, synth probe error rate +0.02%. small but consistent across a few replays.
Oliver: is it all payloads or a subset?
Mira: seems concentrated on short prompts (~<40 tokens). replay traces show extra decode iterations, looks like tokenizer/model variant mismatch.
Jana: can we narrow the replay to the exact prod traces that hit eu-embed? i'll run it.
Mira: do that and post the replay command/output. pausing rollout until we have triage? @deploy-bot pause-rollout please.
deploy-bot: rollout pause requested by Mira. Canary traffic held at 20%. (user: Mira) :white_check_mark:
James: +1 to pause. if it's tokenizer mismatch i'd prefer pinning route to 2026.2-stable while we triage.
Sam: also capture kv-cache warmup / prefix-cache logs during replay — might be an interaction with short-seq batching.
Jana: running a focused recorded replay now with the prod trace slice. command:
```
./replay --source=prod-traces/2026-03-19-eu --routes=eu-embed --mode=recorded --concurrency=6 --window=short-prompts --output=artifacts/replay-1741234560.log
```
Mira: nice, drop the log here when done. also enable --tokenizer-debug on one node so we get token diffs.
Oliver: replay log excerpt (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:03Z] request_id=abc123 route=eu-embed tokens_in=28 tokens_out=110 decode_steps=112
[2026-03-19T14:02:03Z] tokenizer: warning: unknown sequence -> fallback to byte-pair for token 0x9f
[2026-03-19T14:02:04Z] model-variant: selected quant-8 variant (v2.3) but manifest expects v2.2 tokenizer map
```
Jana: that second line matches what i saw locally. some recent packaging of v2.3 left an old tokenizer mapping out of sync for the eu-embed variant.
Mira: ok that explains extra decode steps. decision time: keep rollout paused, pin eu-embed route to 2026.2-stable, and schedule full replay across all short-prompt windows overnight.
James: i'll open a quick rollback/pin PR and attach the replay log.
Sam: we should also add a smoke probe check that validates tokenizer manifest version for the route during postdeploy. small change but catches this class of mismatch early.
Mira: agreed — add to the smoke checklist: verify tokenizer-manifest == model-variant.manifest.
Jana: replay completed — uploading log to artifacts/replay-1741234560.log, size 2.4MB.
deploy-bot: pin applied: route=eu-embed -> version=2026.2-stable (applied by James). Canary remains paused.
Mira: thanks all. we'll reconvene in 1h to review full-replay results and decide whether to roll forward after tokenizer fix. :thumbsup:
